PLAY · MAGNETS ATTRACT METAL

Bear’s Magnet Mystery

Bear has a big magnet! Tap a picture, then tap the bin where it belongs. What will the magnet grab?

Tap a picture, then tap the bin where it belongs.

Magnet mystery solved!

The steel clip, iron nail and steel washer stick. The pencil, spoon and eraser are left behind!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Magnets only grab iron and steel — the name of the material is written right on each card. Say the material names together, then raid the kitchen drawer with a real fridge magnet (spoons first!).

Illustration note: Scientifically fair: everything on the ATTRACTS side is iron or steel; the pencil is wood, the spoon plastic, the eraser rubber.

Prefer paper? The Bear’s Magnet Mystery worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
